name: Daily desk playbooks
description: Organize Downloads and the Desktop by moving files, summarise a folder, prep a meeting, draft a message, plan the day, and add one hisab line. Nothing is deleted. A send waits for approval.
author: FRIDAY library

steps.label: Move Downloads and Desktop files into a dated folder
steps.postcondition: Each file is in the dated folder and still exists.
steps.undo: Move the files back to the folder they came from.

steps.label: Summarise the folder and propose renames
steps.postcondition: A list of names is written and no file is removed.

steps.label: Prepare meeting notes from the next event
steps.postcondition: The note names the next event and stays local.

steps.label: Draft the message and do not send it
steps.postcondition: A draft exists and was not sent.

steps.label: Send the draft after approval
steps.postcondition: The draft was sent only after the owner approved it.

steps.label: Write reminders and the day plan
steps.postcondition: The plan lists the open tasks for the day.

steps.label: Add one hisab line from the receipt
steps.postcondition: One ledger line was added and the receipt text stays data.
